_what: The mutation surface of the harness this product is built in, inventoried from the tool surface actually offered to the session on 2026-09-04. The guard's classification, the hook matcher in .claude/settings.json and the drill's coverage are all DERIVED from this file (Canon: derive every guarded set; never hand-list it in three places). A tool that appears in the environment and not here is an UNCOVERED ROUTE, not a safe one: scripts/doctrine-gate.py fails when the matcher and this file disagree, and the honest consequence is recorded in PRODUCT_STATE obligation OBL-GAL-009.
inventory_method: Enumerated from the session's own tool listing (direct tools, deferred tools announced by the harness, and connected MCP servers github / Google_Drive / Claude_Code_Remote). Re-run the inventory whenever the harness announces new tools; this file is the thing that must change.

classes.READ_ONLY: Cannot change repository, deployment, published or external state. Never denied; deliberately NOT matched by the hook so that a malfunctioning guard can never block inspection or diagnosis.
classes.LOCAL_WRITE: Writes files in the working tree. Route: file path.
classes.SHELL: Arbitrary local acts including git, package managers, deploy CLIs. Route: command string.
classes.REMOTE_REPO_WRITE: Changes a GitHub repository through the API without touching the local working tree or local git hooks. This route bypasses .githooks entirely.
classes.PUBLICATION: Puts content outside the repository where other people can read it.
classes.DELEGATION: Starts another agent or session that carries its own tool surface.
classes.EXTERNAL_WRITE: Writes state in a third-party system or another session.
classes.SCHEDULING: Creates durable triggers that act later, outside this session.
classes.SESSION_LOCAL: Bookkeeping that lives and dies with this session and changes nothing a later reader could be misled by. Never denied and deliberately not matched: a guard that interrupts a to-do list teaches the operator to switch it off, which is the real failure mode.

namespace_rules._what: A tool that appears inside a covered namespace but is not listed above is classified by verb, so a new MCP tool is not silently unguarded.

uncovered_routes_declared.route: A tool the harness adds after this inventory that matches no namespace rule
uncovered_routes_declared.downstream: The change still has to become a commit to matter; .githooks and the CI job at the pull-request chokepoint are the layers that see it regardless of route.

uncovered_routes_declared.route: Tool calls made by a subagent started through Agent/Task/Workflow
uncovered_routes_declared.state: UNKNOWN — whether the harness applies this project's PreToolUse hooks inside a subagent's own tool loop is not provable from inside the repository
uncovered_routes_declared.downstream: Delegation itself is a guarded act, so an unoriented session cannot start one; and the same downstream layers apply.

uncovered_routes_declared.route: A human operating git in this checkout outside any agent session
uncovered_routes_declared.state: By design not a hook concern
uncovered_routes_declared.downstream: .githooks/pre-commit and pre-push, which are fail-closed and bypassable only with an explicit --no-verify; CI is the layer that closes that.
